full_page.content:
1956, February 5
sister Martha Page Two
Please God, I must reach Pat, with a letter
soon. Though there so many urgently crying for help, that one heartly known which one to help first. This is almost continuely. God's will be done, in all His blessed designs.
In conclusion let us exhort one another on every occasion to be gratuateful to God for the un- countable graces by which we are surrounded.
I am dictating this letter to one of my brothers, my dear brothers. Brother Gabriel.
With loving regards to Brother Patrick, Sisters M. Genevieve, Margaret and all our dear ones in the West. I remain
Sincerely yours in the Sacred Hearts of Jesus and Mary,
Your Brother B. - Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
